convert_to_coco_json: convert a detectron2 dataset to COCO JSON format and save it to a specified output file
create_COCOEvaluator: create a COCOEvaluator instance to evaluate bbox, segmentation, and keypoint detection metrics on a dataset
run_COCOEvaluator_evaluate: run the COCOEvaluator evaluate method to compute AP and AR metrics on collected predictions
instances_to_coco_json: convert detectron2 Instances objects into a COCO-format JSON list for evaluation
